title: Rails Basics
intro: Rails basics interview questions for freshers cover what interviewers expect a junior Rails developer to know walking in. This module covers Rails MVC (Model — data and business logic, View — presentation, Controller — orchestration and glue), convention over configuration and what it means in practice, the directory structure of a new Rails app and what lives where, routes (resources :posts generates 7 RESTful routes — know all 7), controller basics (inherits from ApplicationController, actions are public methods, params hash), the difference between render (same request, same action) and redirect_to (new HTTP request), instance variables in controllers that flow to views, before_action, flash messages, and the most useful Rails console commands. Every answer traces the full request → response path.
